Status Detail.value: A draft air permit to construct, number ACP-18345 version 1.0, for 192 diesel emergency generator engines at the FAR Generation Plant in Harwood was open for public comment from June 15 to July 15, 2026. Each of the two buildings holds 96 Caterpillar 3516E engines of 3,000 kilowatts.
Status Detail.note: The North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality air quality effects analysis from June 11, 2026 at https://deq.nd.gov/aq/Notices/AppliedDigital/DRAFTACP18345v1_0AQEA.pdf gives the comment dates, the engine count and the engine model. The state notice letter from June 2026 at https://deq.nd.gov/aq/Notices/AppliedDigital/20260611BaylisLtrandNOT.pdf says the department proposes to issue the permit for 192 emergency generators at the FAR Generation Plant. Both are from the same agency, so they count as one source. I found no final permit or later notice, so the status stays pre-construction.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: The database already shows this model for FAR01 but gives no source for it. The draft air permit to construct ACP-18345 from the Department of Environmental Quality lists 96 Caterpillar 3516E generator engines of 3,000 kilowatts for building FAR01, and the department's air quality analysis says the same. Both are from one publisher.

units.notes: The draft permit gives building FAR01 96 Caterpillar 3516E engines of 3 MW each, which is 288 MW of diesel, the same as GEM shows. The 192 engines and 576 MW across both buildings also match GEM, and Backup Power yes fits. No start year or scheduled operating date was found. Latest Activity is left alone because the newest report is from June 2026, under a year old. No final permit was found.

qa.question: Can the Harwood plant point be made exact from the 6805 County Road 81 address?
qa.finding: The air quality analysis at https://deq.nd.gov/aq/Notices/AppliedDigital/DRAFTACP18345v1_0AQEA.pdf gives the site address as 6805 County Road 81, Harwood, ND 58042. The geocoder found no match for that address, and only placed Harwood town about 2.4 km from GEM's point.
qa.recommendation: Leave the point as approximate. Place 6805 County Road 81 using Cass County parcel records or a map and then mark it exact.
qa.note: I tried the geocoder with several spellings. A web search found a data center listing with the same address but no coordinates. A satellite image of GEM's point, Esri World Imagery at zoom 15, shows bare farm fields east of Interstate 29 near Harwood, with no buildings yet. The imagery is older than the construction, so it cannot place the plant. The Internet Archive was offline during this pass, so older Harwood notices could not be read there.

qa.question: Should the permit number on the June 2026 Harwood notice letter be treated as a typo?
qa.finding: The notice letter at https://deq.nd.gov/aq/Notices/AppliedDigital/20260611BaylisLtrandNOT.pdf names the FAR Generation Plant but its comment line gives permit ACP-18338 version 1.0, which is the Ellendale permit. The analysis at https://deq.nd.gov/aq/Notices/AppliedDigital/DRAFTACP18345v1_0AQEA.pdf says ACP-18345 version 1.0.
qa.recommendation: Use ACP-18345 for Harwood and treat the letter's number as a copy error.
qa.note: The commission case PU-26-155 covers the Ellendale site per the earlier pass and does not name Harwood.
